Library Description
The Kakatiya University College of Engineering and Technology (KUCET) library supports the academic and research needs of students, faculty, and staff.
Open Access System:
Users can directly browse the collection.
Organized Sections:
The library has various sections, including Reference, Circulation, Periodicals, and Competitive Exam Material.
Classification:
Uses the Dewey Decimal System and AACR-II cataloging.
Operating Hours:
8:00 AM – 8:00 PM (Weekdays), 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Sundays & Second Saturdays).
Library Rules and Regulations
Identity Card is required for access.
Maintain silence and order inside the library.
Students can borrow up to
four books
.
Late returns will incur fines.
Lost books must be replaced or paid for.
Marking/writing in books is strictly prohibited.
Reference books are available for in-library study only.
Borrower cards are non-transferable.
Tearing pages from books/newspapers is strictly forbidden.
Students must return their library cards to obtain a "No-Due" certificate.
